Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You quantify copper’s rise alongside its cost share—it sounds like you want the adjustment understood as cost recovery, not simply a higher price. We want a fair, explainable agreement that supports our long-standing partnership and gives both sides planning confidence. How can we balance payment timing and price to address that cost pressure sustainably?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your volume confirmation of 6,110 units; however, an extension of payment terms to 90 days incurs additional financing costs that preclude any price reduction. Consequently, our current Angebot stands at a price of €373.97 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

To accommodate your request for a more favorable unit price, we must maintain the standard 30-day payment term. Consequently, we propose a revised price of €369.85 per unit, and we request verifiable data to substantiate your proposed price level. As an alternative at our standard terms, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net, we offer a price of €369.85 per unit, no Preisgleitklausel. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €369.85 per unit. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You return repeatedly to standard payment terms; it sounds like the financing burden is what limits your room on price. We want an agreement that recognises your cost pressures and preserves a sustainable long-term partnership, with our verified demand outlook supporting reliable planning. How can we balance payment timing and price so that financing costs do not stand in the way of agreement?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 365.31 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Extended payment terms of 90 days incur substantial financing costs that restrict our pricing flexibility. To accommodate your request for a lower unit price, we propose returning to our standard 30-day payment term. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot is a price of €372.76 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with standard terms of a price of €368.65 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

It sounds like financing costs are a key constraint on your pricing flexibility, since you link faster payment directly to a lower price. We want a sustainable agreement that respects your cost pressures and supports our long-standing partnership. How can we balance payment timing and price so that the agreement works fairly for both sides?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 366.21 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our current offer is a price of €372.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

We acknowledge your revised offer, but the extended 90-day payment term continues to impose financing costs that restrict our pricing flexibility. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

To address your request to balance payment timing and price, we have changed the payment term to our standard 30 days in exchange for a reduced unit price of €368.05. This alternative of a price of €368.05 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel is at our standard terms. 

We trust this adjustment provides the fair balance you are seeking for both sides. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

We want a fair, sustainable agreement that recognises that burden and preserves the value of our long-standing partnership. Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
